svg.text: wrdata tb_bbl_slot_shared.dat v(analog_bus0) v(analog_bus1) v(analog_bus2) v(analog_bus3)
tb_bbl_slot_shared: slot with harness bus switch, bus line and LED amplifier input per bus
dig_in in the code block (N0 tuning code 1 here); vbias open (on-chip pull-up: full coupling)
LED amplifier: ultra-high-impedance input modelled as 1 Tohm || 5 pF; Cb = bus line + pad (+ external)
